title: Measuring Units
parentNote: Let him point to real things at home (a spoon, a bucket, a table) while answering — measurement clicks best when it's hands-on.
learnBullets: Which **tool** measures what (length, weight, capacity, time, temperature)
The right **unit** to use for small vs. big things (cm vs. m, g vs. kg)
learnItFirst:
| We want to measure... | We use... | Units |
|---|---|---|
| **Length** (how long/tall) | 📏 Ruler / measuring tape | centimetres (cm), metres (m) |
| **Weight** (how heavy) | ⚖️ Weighing scale | grams (g), kilograms (kg) |
| **Capacity** (how much liquid) | 🥤 Measuring cup/jug | millilitres (mL), litres (L) |
| **Time** | 🕐 Clock | minutes, hours |
| **Temperature** (how hot/cold) | 🌡️ Thermometer | degrees |

**Small thing → small unit.** A button is weighed in **grams**; an elephant is weighed in **kilograms**. A pencil is measured in **centimetres**; a playground is measured in **metres**.

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Decide** — am I measuring length, weight, capacity, time, or temperature?
2. **Pick** the correct tool or unit for the SIZE of the thing.
3. **Compare** carefully — check which side of the balance goes down (that side is heavier!).

---

questions.content: Which tool measures length?
questions.why: A ruler/measuring tape is used for length

questions.content: Which tool measures weight?
questions.why: A weighing scale is used for weight

questions.content: Which tool measures temperature?
questions.why: A thermometer measures how hot or cold something is

questions.content: Which tool tells us the time?
questions.why: A clock tells us the time

questions.content: Which tool measures how much water a jug can hold?
questions.why: A measuring cup/jug is used for capacity (liquids)

questions.content: Which is longer — a pencil ✏️ or a school bus 🚌?
questions.why: A bus is much bigger and longer than a pencil

questions.content: Which is heavier — an elephant 🐘 or a ball ⚽?
questions.why: An elephant is much heavier than a small ball

questions.content: Which holds more water — a bucket 🪣 or a spoon 🥄?
questions.why: A bucket is bigger, so it holds more water than a spoon

questions.content: Which is taller — a tree 🌳 or a flower 🌸?
questions.why: A tree grows much taller than a flower

questions.content: Which takes more time — sleeping a whole night 🌙 or blinking your eye 👁️?
questions.why: A whole night is many hours; a blink is less than a second

questions.content: Which unit do we use to measure the length of a pencil?
questions.why: Small objects like a pencil are measured in centimetres

questions.content: Which unit do we use to measure your own weight?
questions.why: A person's weight is measured in kilograms

questions.content: Which unit do we use to measure how much milk is in a bottle?
questions.why: Liquids like milk are measured in litres

questions.content: Which unit do we use to measure the length of a football ground?
questions.why: Long distances like a ground are measured in metres

questions.content: Which is the shortest — a pencil (15 cm), an eraser (4 cm), or a ruler (30 cm)?
questions.why: 4 cm is smaller than both 15 cm (pencil) and 30 cm (ruler)

questions.content: On a see-saw balance, the side with 🐘 goes DOWN and the side with 🐭 goes UP. Which is heavier?
questions.why: The side that goes DOWN on a balance is the heavier side

questions.content: On a balance, 🍎 goes DOWN and 🍇 goes UP. Which is heavier?
questions.why: The side that goes DOWN is heavier — 🍎 went down

questions.content: A table is 6 hand-spans long. Each book is 2 hand-spans long. How many books fit side by side to equal the table's length?
questions.why: 6 hand-spans ÷ 2 hand-spans per book = 3 books

questions.content: A rope is measured as 5 pencil-lengths. Each pencil is about 10 cm long. About how long is the rope?
questions.why: 5 pencils × 10 cm each = 50 cm

questions.content: Which holds more water — a bathtub 🛁 or a teacup ☕?
questions.why: A bathtub is much bigger than a teacup

questions.content: Which is the better unit to weigh an elephant?
questions.why: Heavy things like an elephant are weighed in kilograms

questions.content: Which is the better unit to weigh a small button?
questions.why: Light things like a button are weighed in grams

questions.content: 🐘 is the heaviest, 🐶 is medium, and 🐭 is the lightest. Which order is correct from LIGHTEST to HEAVIEST?
questions.why: Lightest to heaviest: mouse, dog, elephant

questions.content: A glass 🥛 holds less than a jug 🫙, and a jug holds less than a bucket 🪣. Which holds the MOST?
questions.why: Bucket > jug > glass, so the bucket holds the most

questions.content: Which takes MORE time — eating a full meal 🍽️ or taking one sip of water 🥤?
questions.why: A full meal takes many minutes; a sip takes a second

questions.content: A rope is 3 times as long as a ruler. The ruler is 30 cm long. How long is the rope?
Riya's table is 4 of her hand-spans long. Her friend measures the SAME table and gets only 3 of his hand-spans. Whose hand-span is bigger?
questions.why: Fewer, bigger spans were needed to cover the same table

questions.content: A bucket needs 8 mugs of water to fill it completely. A smaller tub needs only 4 mugs. How many times bigger is the bucket than the tub?
questions.why: 8 mugs ÷ 4 mugs = 2 times bigger

questions.content: On a balance, 🍉 (one watermelon) exactly balances 4 🍎 (apples). If one apple weighs 100 g, how much does the watermelon weigh?
questions.why: 4 apples × 100 g each = 400 g

questions.content: A classroom is measured as 10 metres long with a big tape, and also as 1000 cm long using a small ruler moved again and again. Are both measurements the same length?

options.C: No, different tools give different answers

questions.why: 1 metre = 100 cm, so 10 m = 1000 cm — same length, different units
